Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: They misidentified the first citation by treating the superscript anchor (#cite_note-thb-1) as the target link, then assumed it led to the MFAH page. They subsequently scraped the first img on the MFAH page (the site logo) and even hardcoded an unverified “internal/media/dispatcher” URL, which was not a valid image. This led to the UnidentifiedImageError and prevented extracting the date from the correct image, directly causing the task to fail.
